concepts.title: Topics covered
concepts.text_md:
- Unlimited Q&A Session — every question answered
- Career Guidance for Cloud DevOps SRE and Architect paths
- Placement Strategy & Job Application Tips
- Portfolio Review — GitHub and LinkedIn final check
- Community Networking — peer connections matter
- Certificate Distribution and next steps guidance

concepts.title: Key learnings
concepts.text_md:
- Your GitHub portfolio plus LinkedIn profile IS your resume in the DevOps market
- Network beats Skills beats Resume — the right referral opens doors certifications cannot
- Target companies by tech stack and apply where your exact skills are required
- Negotiate with data: research Glassdoor AmbitionBox LinkedIn Salary before every offer
- You are not a fresher anymore — you are a Multi-Cloud DevOps Engineer with 8 real projects
